title: Miniature matrix debug mode
summary: A shared app checkbox controls temporary firmware projection of original 60x60 animations onto the purchased 10x6 matrix. Command, GPIO1 mini-only output and ESP 5V power choice are approved; the owner's photo identifies the IN/5V/GND pads and the linked LED specification supports 3.3V data for that part. Exact ESP-board 5V current and USB power-path capacity still require verification before claiming a fully validated wiring plan.
